mem.9:
Evan and Sam — conversation memory through 27 August 2023

- By 18 May, Evan had recently returned from a family trip in his new Prius. His old Prius broke down; he repaired and sold it. From 11–17 May, he and his family visited the Rockies and hiked. Sam fondly remembered a long hike with their father at age 10, had not settled on a hobby, and was considering trying painting.
- Evan began watercolor a few years before May 2023 after a friend introduced him to it and offered advice. He found it calming, expressive, and helpful for stress.
- On 20–21 May, Evan took his family to Jasper, drove the Icefields Parkway, saw glaciers and lakes, and stayed in a cozy cabin among mountains and forests. On 24 May, he shared a photo described as a person holding a book in front of a lake while saying he had taken a glacier photo.
- A few days before 24 May, Sam had a check-up and found the weight measurement eye-opening. Evan encouraged painting for stress, enjoyable exercise, and small healthier food changes. Sam planned to try painting without worrying about the result.
- From 29 May–4 June, Evan had a sudden, frightening heart palpitation that prompted lifestyle changes. By 6 June he was trying to eat less processed food and fewer sugary snacks; ginger snaps remained a weakness. Sam wanted healthier habits but still liked soda and candy. They agreed to try flavored seltzer and high-cocoa dark chocolate instead. Evan offered to show Sam basic exercises and said exercise cleared his mind. Sam was also irritated that all supermarket self-checkouts were broken.
- On 21 July, Sam’s friends mocked their weight, which hurt and motivated them to make changes. On 27 July, Evan offered support, saying he had struggled with health a few years earlier and had persisted. He shared a gym membership card as a reminder of his commitment and a fresh-produce photo; he said reducing sugary snacks and eating more fruit and vegetables helped. Sam was cutting down soda and candy, liked flavored seltzer, and planned to start regular gym exercise on 28 July. Evan suggested seltzer with air-popped popcorn or fruit. At that time he was reading *The Great Gatsby*.
- From 31 July–6 August, Evan traveled to Canada and met an “awesome” Canadian woman (name unknown); being with her made him feel alive and their time together was fun and energizing. On 13 August he said he had returned from a Canada vacation with his new significant other; they hiked, biked, and explored outdoors. He shared a photo of a tent in a grassy field.
- On 7 August, Evan said he had health issues and had been working on his health for two years, with ups and downs. His family motivated him; he shared a photo of his children playing on a swing set and said they brought him joy. He recommended Sam use a fitness watch to track progress and stay motivated. Hikes and adventure also motivated him; he shared a photo of a small island with a lone boat.
- Evan got a bonsai tree because it symbolized strength and resilience. Caring for it encouraged him through hard times and reminded him that people can be tough even in little things. He valued small self-care acts, consistency, and perseverance.
- On 12 August, Sam dreamed of soaring over skyscrapers and feeling incredible, and wondered what it meant; Evan suggested a dream-interpretation book. On 13 August, Evan said he had been searching for his keys for half an hour and lost them every week. Sam offered to cheer him on after sleeping. Sam said health challenges affected them and supportive people like Evan helped them stay positive; shared a notepad, pen, and note with the quote “Don't fear it, just take the first step.” Sam stressed progress over perfection and celebrating small wins, though the health journey sometimes felt endless.
- On 12 August, Evan’s son hurt his ankle in a soccer accident. Evan cared for him and took him to the doctor; on 15 August he shared a photo of a person with a foot cast. The ankle was improving but sore; it had been rough initially but was not serious.
- On 15 August, Sam described a tough week and a doctor’s appointment that was a wake-up call to care for themself. Sam was taking a cooking class to learn healthier meals and had made marinated grilled salmon with vegetables the previous night, sharing a photo and offering recipes. Evan wanted more vegetables and Sam offered an easy roasted-vegetable recipe. Sam felt concerned but motivated to take changes one step at a time; Evan reassured them.
- On 19 August, Sam said they were dieting and living healthier despite difficulty, and shared spinach, avocado, and strawberries. They had more energy and felt less sluggish. Sam shared a grilled chicken-and-vegetable stir-fry recipe: two bowls with chopsticks and homemade sauce, plus a recipe-card photo featuring a vase-of-flowers drawing. Evan said he would try it.
- A few days before 19 August, Evan started watercolor painting classes to meet like-minded people and show his work; he believed skills could always improve. He said a friend’s painting had originally inspired him. He shared a forest painting on an easel, painting tools (brush, pencil, eyeliners on cloth), a sunset-over-ocean painting, and a pink-flowered tree in a field. The class focused on watercolor and observing/painting nature. He found it relaxing, loved landscapes, and said nature brought him peace. He shared a photo of a truck parked in a forest and said places like that brought back road-trip memories in his “trusty car.”
- Evan said he had driven somewhere fun the previous month and shared a photo of a person skiing on a snowy trail. Sam asked if it was Banff; Evan confirmed, said the snow was amazing, and hoped to return the next year. He enjoys skiing, snowboarding, and ice skating. Sam would like to try skiing but was unsure their body could handle it; Evan hoped they could join him in winter activities someday. Sam appreciated his understanding and said it might be possible.
- On 27 August, Sam said they had started a new diet and exercise routine on Monday, 21 August, and felt great. Evan said he had twisted his knee on Friday, 25 August; it was painful and frustrating because being active mattered greatly to him. Sam sympathized and offered help. Evan said physical therapy was planned but he was awaiting an appointment; meanwhile he was taking it easy and swimming. Sam encouraged swimming as low-impact.
- Evan mentioned a book he had discussed earlier, saying it got better with every page and he could not put it down. Sam said he had made them curious about it.
- On 27 August, Evan shared a photo of a car parked by a lake with mountains in the background, from a road trip the previous month, and said nature relaxed him. He had gone to the Rocky Mountains and found it refreshing. Sam had not road-tripped in ages but loved nature and wanted to hike more as their health improved. Evan suggested hikes and proposed going together; he shared a lake-and-mountain photo. Sam asked which lake and whether it was nearby. Evan recommended the pictured lake, saying there were many trails and it was a two-hour drive away, worth it for the views and peaceful atmosphere. Sam said a day trip was doable and planned to visit. They wished each other well and said goodbye.

They wished each other safety and looked forward to the trail.
- 2023-10-25: Sam struggled to maintain health routine and felt family pressure. Evan empathized; morning walks helped him start the day. He encouraged patience and gradual progress, sharing that two years earlier he changed diet and walked regularly (photo of him at table with fruit and vegetables). Focusing on well-being rather than quick results and letting go of pressure helped physically and mentally. Sam found his transformation inspiring; Evan advised one day at a time and celebrating small victories.

He had lost his job the previous month due to company downsizing and was looking for another, staying hopeful. Sam offered support. Evan shared a beach/surfboard-at-sunset photo taken 2023-11-03 at his favorite peaceful beach near home; waves and sunset colors relaxed him in tough times and reminded him of nature’s resilience.
